review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for IsQuasiSeparated, QuasiSeparatedSpace and compactness-of-intersection predicates. The closest existing concept is `IsRetrocompact` in Mathlib/Topology/Constructible.lean. It says `s ∩ U` is compact for every compact open `U`, so it is a property of one set `s` relative to all compact opens. `IsQuasiSeparated s` and `QuasiSeparatedSpace` instead say that two compact opens inside `s` (or in the space) intersect in a compact set. They are different notions. Constructible.lean already relates them with `QuasiSeparatedSpace.isRetrocompact_iff_isCompact` and `QuasiSeparatedSpace.of_isOpenCover`, and uses both. The T2 and Noetherian instances, `IsQuasiSeparated`, and the AlgebraicGeometry morphism-level `QuasiSeparated` (a different, morphism-level notion) do not compete with each other. Core and Batteries have nothing topological. I found no independent declaration that duplicates one in this file, so I abstain.
